text: Which series of models is OpenAI best known for developing?
options: The GPT series of large language models
The Claude series of large language models
The Gemini series of large language models
The Llama series of large language models
answer: The GPT series of large language models
explanation: GPT stands for generative pre-trained transformer, and the name has been carried through the whole line since the original 2018 model. The other three series on this list belong to Anthropic, Google and Meta, which is a quick way to rule three options out and check the fourth.
answerAliases: generative pre-trained transformer (GPT) series of large language models

text: Anthropic and OpenAI are both headquartered in the same American city. Which city?
explanation: Both are public benefit corporations registered and based in San Francisco, and both were founded by people who had just left the same organisation. The overlap in people, funding and hiring is the single largest structural fact about the frontier lab industry.

text: Which French AI company, founded in 2023 and based in Paris, is known for open weight language models?
explanation: Mistral released the Mixtral mixture of experts model under an Apache licence, which was the first genuinely competitive open weight model from a European lab. The valuation above 14 billion dollars makes it the most valuable European AI company.

text: Which Hangzhou based AI company develops open weight models and is owned and funded by a hedge fund?
explanation: DeepSeek is funded by High-Flyer, which is unusual, since it means the research is not being driven by outside investors looking for a return. Their reasoning models made strong performance on math and code benchmarks at unusually low cost, and the models were released with open weights.
answerAliases: Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd.

text: Which Seattle based non-profit research institute was founded in 2014 by Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen?
explanation: Ai2, as it styles itself, was built to do open research rather than to ship products, and the distinction matters. The Allen Institute for Brain Science is a separate organisation in Seattle that studies neural tissue, and the two are easy to mix up because they share a name and a benefactor.

source.title: Allen Institute for AI
source.label: Allen Institute for AI on Wikipedia

text: Which lab was founded in 2010, acquired by Google in 2014, and later merged with Google Brain in 2023?
explanation: DeepMind was founded in London and became the company behind AlphaGo, AlphaFold and Gemini. Google paid a reported 400 million pounds for it, and the merge with Google Brain in April 2023 is what created the awkward situation of two research groups with the same name inside one company.

text: Which Toronto based company focuses on large language models for regulated industries such as banking and healthcare?
explanation: Aidan Gomez, Ivan Zhang and Nick Frosst founded Cohere in 2019, and Gomez was also the first author of the transformer paper that everything modern is built on. The pitch is deployment inside regulated companies rather than a consumer chatbot, which is a slower business with far fewer users.

text: In which year did Google merge DeepMind with its Google Brain division to form Google DeepMind?
explanation: Google had already bought DeepMind in 2014, and for nine years it and Google Brain ran as separate organisations with overlapping goals. The 2023 merge left one research lab with a duplicated name inside it, which is a fairly ordinary outcome of acquisitions and an unusually visible one here.

text: Which lab develops the Claude family of AI models?
explanation: Claude is the flagship product of Anthropic, the public benefit corporation founded in January 2021 by former OpenAI members including Dario and Daniela Amodei with an explicit AI safety mission. OpenAI is the tempting wrong answer because the Amodeis came from there, but OpenAI builds the GPT series, not Claude.

text: Which lab develops the Gemini family of AI models?
explanation: Google DeepMind is responsible for the proprietary Gemini family alongside the open-weight Gemma models, after Google merged DeepMind with the Google Brain division in April 2023. OpenAI is the closest distractor since GPT and Gemini compete head to head, but GPT belongs to OpenAI.

text: Which lab develops the Llama family of AI models?
explanation: Meta AI is the research division behind the Llama models, which Meta released with open weights and built its Meta AI assistant on. Mistral AI is the natural confusion because the Paris lab also publishes open-weight models, but its family is Mistral and Mixtral, not Llama.

text: Which lab develops the Grok family of AI models?
explanation: Grok is the primary product of xAI, the company founded by Elon Musk whose first model, Grok 1, was released in November 2023. OpenAI is the trap here because Musk co-founded it, but he left and built Grok at xAI instead.

text: Which former OpenAI chief scientist co-founded Safe Superintelligence Inc.?
explanation: Ilya Sutskever founded SSI with Daniel Gross and Daniel Levy after leaving OpenAI in May 2024, with a mission focused on building safe superintelligence. Sam Altman is the closest distractor as the OpenAI CEO whose brief removal preceded Sutskever's exit, but Altman stayed and Sutskever left to start SSI.

text: Which former OpenAI chief technology officer founded Thinking Machines Lab in 2025?
explanation: Mira Murati, OpenAI's former chief technology officer, founded Thinking Machines Lab in February 2025 as a San Francisco public benefit corporation. Ilya Sutskever is the tempting alternative because he also left OpenAI to found a lab, but his lab is SSI, founded a year earlier.

text: What does World Labs, the startup founded by Fei-Fei Li, build?
options: AI accelerator chips for data centers
explanation: World Labs came out of stealth in September 2024 with $230 million in funding to build large world models that perceive and interact with the 3D world, aimed at artists, designers and game studios. Protein folding is DeepMind's AlphaFold territory, while Li's bet is that spatial intelligence is the frontier after language.

text: Which AI lab was created by Google LaMDA developers Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas?
explanation: Shazeer and De Freitas built LaMDA at Google, then left to found Character.ai, whose beta opened in September 2022 with customizable characters that users define and publish. Inflection AI is the closest distractor because it is also a chatbot lab, but its product was Pi and its founders came from DeepMind, not LaMDA.
